title: Finite-site section colimit presentation compatible with all source units
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $j$, let $P_j$ be a precoverage on $F(j)$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with isomorphism covers, finite indexed composition and base-change stability [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and covering pullbacks. Assume every covering presieve has finitely many arrows. Each transition functor $F(a)$ maps covering presieves to covering presieves, preserves pullbacks of a covering arrow along any arrow, and is continuous for the generated topologies. Let $V$ be a cocone of $F$ whose object and arrow set cocones are colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ with the same finite closure, isomorphism and covering-pullback properties. Its covers are precisely transported images along the $V_j$ of stage covers. Assume each $V_j$ is continuous and preserves covering pullbacks. Fix $j\in J$, an abelian sheaf $H$ on $P_j$, and an object $X\in F(j)$. There exist a diagram $D:J_{j/}\to\mathrm{Ab}$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], a natural transformation $e$ from the constant diagram $H(X)$ to $D$, a cocone $c$ of $D$, isomorphisms $\alpha_a:D(a)\cong (F(a)^{-1}H)(F(a)X)$ for each $a:j\to k$, and an isomorphism $\beta:c.pt\cong (V_j^{-1}H)(V_jX)$, such that $c$ is a colimit cocone. For every $a:j\to k$, $e_a$ followed by $\alpha_a$ equals the component at $X$ of the canonical $F(a)$ inverse-image unit, and $e_a$ followed by $c_a$ and $\beta$ equals the component at $X$ of the canonical $V_j$ inverse-image unit. These are equalities of additive maps, simultaneously for all source sections; there is no vanishing assumption.

proof.text: Construct the canonical stage sheaf comparison maps by transposing the composite unit through each stage adjunction. Cocone naturality and Under.w identify the composite restriction functors. Uniqueness of adjuncts proves the unit equations. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-site-abelian-section-diagram] to get D, the stage object isomorphisms, the section cocone and its point isomorphism. Define e at each a as the source unit followed by the inverse stage object isomorphism. The unit and transition equations give naturality of e and its compatibility with every cocone leg.

Form presentations of a limit object Y by stages reached from i, including arrows from i and stage objects with image Y. Joint surjectivity of the object and arrow colimit legs supplies representatives. Filteredness moves any finite set of representatives to a common stage. Eventual equality in these same two supplied colimit cocones gives equality of endpoints and composites after further refinement, and equalizes parallel refinements. Thus the presentation category is filtered. The category above a fixed presentation is final by the common-refinement and equalizer criterion.

Take the filtered colimit of the inverse-image sections on presentations. Lift a restriction arrow to a common stage; eventual equality and naturality of the uniquely unit-characterized transition maps prove independence of the lift and the identity and composition restriction laws. These are a presheaf of abelian groups. Every Q cover lifts by hQ to a finite stage cover, and hVpullback preserves its covering pullbacks. Its sheaf equalizer is the filtered colimit of the finite stage equalizers. Filtered abelian group colimits commute with finite products and equalizers, so the presheaf is a sheaf; the empty-cover condition gives the zero group.

A map from this constructed sheaf to a sheaf H is a compatible family of stage sheaf maps. Apply each stage adjunction to identify this family with one map from G to restriction of H along V_i. The identity presentation and the unit define the reverse assignment. Adjunct uniqueness and the colimit universal property show the assignments are mutually inverse and natural in H. Uniqueness of the left adjoint therefore identifies the constructed sheaf with the canonical sheafPullback, compatibly with units. At V(j)(X), presentations obtained by carrying X forward are final, using common refinements and eventual equality. This identifies their section colimit with the section group of the canonical limit inverse image. Transport the universal property along the stage isomorphisms and the unit-compatible point isomorphism to prove IsColimit c. This step establishes the section formula, without extracting any eventual vanishing witness.

theorem colimit_site_finite_section_colimit_presentation
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (j : J) (H : Sheaf (P j).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (X : F.obj j) :
    ∃ (D : Under j ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
      (e : (Functor.const (Under j)).obj (H.obj.obj (op X)) ⟶ D)
      (c : Cocone D)
      (β : c.pt ≅ ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app j).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj H).obj.obj
          (op ((V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X)))
      (α : ∀ a : Under j, D.obj a ≅
        ((sheafPullback (F.map a.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (P j).toGrothendieck (P a.right).toGrothendieck).obj H).obj.obj
            (op ((F.map a.hom).toFunctor.obj X))),
      Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧
      (∀ a : Under j, e.app a ≫ (α a).hom =
        ((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map a.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (P j).toGrothendieck (P a.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app H).hom.app
            (op X)) ∧
      (∀ a : Under j, e.app a ≫ c.ι.app a ≫ β.hom =
        ((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app j).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app H).hom.app (op X))
